mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,project_id,verification_id,created_by,model_revision,config_id,model_sha256,credential_reference_id,credential_revision,request_json,request_sha256,idempotency_key,operation_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,classification,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,grant_id,grant_revision,audit_id,event_id FROM runtime_connection_intent WHERE verification_id=#{verificationId} LIMIT 2

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,verification_id,created_by,model_revision,config_id,model_sha256,credential_reference_id,credential_revision,request_json,request_sha256,idempotency_key,operation_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,classification,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,grant_id,grant_revision,audit_id,event_id FROM runtime_connection_intent WHERE created_by=#{userId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} LIMIT 2

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,verification_id,run_id,step_id,action_id,invocation_id,request_sha256,input_sha256,model_revision,credential_reference_id,credential_revision,receipt_json,created_by,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,classification FROM runtime_connection_start WHERE verification_id=#{verificationId} LIMIT 2

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,verification_id,invocation_id,artifact_json,receipt_sha256,price_version,currency,settled_amount,usage_receipt_id,audit_id,event_id,created_by,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS created_at,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,classification FROM runtime_connection_completed WHERE verification_id=#{verificationId} LIMIT 2
mapper.update: UPDATE connection_verification SET status='RUNNING',revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE verification_id=#{verificationId} AND config_id=#{configId} AND configuration_kind='MODEL' AND config_revision=#{modelRevision} AND credential_reference_id=#{credentialReferenceId} AND credential_revision=#{credentialRevision} AND created_by=#{userId} AND status='PENDING' AND revision=1

UPDATE connection_verification SET status='PASSED',receipt_ref=#{artifactJson},receipt_artifact_id=#{artifactId},endpoint_identity=#{endpoint},verified_at=#{verifiedAt},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE verification_id=#{verificationId} AND config_id=#{configId} AND configuration_kind='MODEL' AND config_revision=#{modelRevision} AND credential_reference_id=#{credentialReferenceId} AND credential_revision=#{credentialRevision} AND created_by=#{userId} AND status='RUNNING' AND revision=2
mapper.select: SELECT resource_ref FROM audit_event WHERE audit_id=#{auditId} AND subject_id=#{actorId} AND created_by=#{actorId} AND project_id <=> #{projectId} AND action='model.connection.verified' AND request_id=#{operationId} AND trace_id=#{operationId} AND result='SUCCESS' AND reason_code IS NULL AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} LIMIT 2
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{verificationId} AND aggregate_revision=3 AND event_type='model.connection.verified' LIMIT 2

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('project_id',project_id,'verification_id',verification_id,'config_id',config_id,'model_revision',config_revision,'credential_reference_id',credential_reference_id,'credential_revision',credential_revision,'status',status,'receipt_ref',receipt_ref,'receipt_artifact_id',receipt_artifact_id,'endpoint_identity',endpoint_identity,'verified_at',IF(verified_at IS NULL,NULL,DATE_FORMAT(verified_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ')),'error_code',error_code,'schema_version',schema_version,'schema_manifest_sha256',schema_manifest_sha256,'created_by',created_by,'created_at',DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'updated_at',DATE_FORMAT(updated_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'configuration_kind',configuration_kind,'classification',classification,'revision',CAST(revision AS CHAR)) FROM connection_verification WHERE verification_id=#{verificationId} LIMIT 2

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('state',state,'http_status',http_status,'response_ref',response_ref,'error_code',error_code,'revision',CAST(revision AS CHAR),'created_at',DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'updated_at',DATE_FORMAT(updated_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ')) FROM operation_record WHERE operation_id=#{operationId} AND subject_id=#{actorId} AND created_by=#{actorId} AND operation_name='MODEL-CONNECTION-VERIFICATION' AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND request_sha256=#{requestHash} AND target_id=#{verificationId} AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} LIMIT 2
mapper.update: UPDATE operation_record SET state='COMPLETED',http_status=200,response_ref=#{receiptJson},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE operation_id=#{operationId} AND subject_id=#{userId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND target_id=#{verificationId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND operation_name='MODEL-CONNECTION-VERIFICATION' AND request_sha256=#{requestHash} AND error_code IS NULL AND state='PROCESSING' AND revision=1
mapper.select: SELECT resource_ref FROM audit_event WHERE audit_id=#{auditId} AND subject_id=#{actorId} AND created_by=#{actorId} AND project_id <=> #{projectId} AND action='model.connection.requested' AND request_id=#{operationId} AND trace_id=#{operationId} AND result='SUCCESS' AND reason_code IS NULL AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND classification=#{classification} LIMIT 2
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{verificationId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='model.connection.requested' LIMIT 2
